name: zcode-loop
description: Measurement loop for ZCode: state a goal and a mechanical metric, let the agent change one thing at a time, keep what moves the number, revert what does not, and keep an auditable ledger of every trial.

description_i18n.en: Measurement loop for ZCode: state a goal and a mechanical metric, let the agent change one thing at a time, keep what moves the number, revert what does not, and keep an auditable ledger of every trial.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 自主实验循环：定目标与机械度量，agent 每次只改一处，跑基准、保留有效改动、回滚无效改动，并留下可审计的试验账本。

maxMinutes.title: 每轮时长上限（分钟）
maxMinutes.description: 默认 120。超时后 Stop 钩子不再续跑。

maxFailures.title: 连续失败上限
maxFailures.description: 默认 3。连续 error/drop 达到该值即停止续跑。

benchTimeoutMs.title: 基准超时（毫秒）
benchTimeoutMs.description: 单次基准命令的墙钟超时，默认 600000。

gateTimeoutMs.title: 门禁超时（毫秒）
gateTimeoutMs.description: 正确性门禁脚本的超时，默认 300000。
